title: Single-source the coach rung copy both coaches print
body:
## Summary
The two coaches print different action words and hints for the same ladder rung: GlobalCoach reads COACH_HINT, NextStepCoach reads nextActionableStep's private present().

## Description
src/components/layout-lab/coachLadder.ts:62-64 COACH_HINT gives pending='Settle' ('produced but held'), unproduced='Start'. src/components/layout-lab/nextActionableStep.ts:50-53 present() gives both 'Start here' (index 0) or 'Do next', and a pending hint 'its acceptance is still resolving'. coachLadder.ts:33-34 promises a change there changes BOTH coaches; that holds for the ORDER, not the copy. Fixed = present() derives actionWord/hint from COACH_HINT (index-0 'Start here' kept as a declared variant). nextActionableStep.ts is outside this context's paths.

## Flow
- open an entity whose first incomplete step is unproduced with no verdict
- GlobalCoach row reads 'Start: <catalog> · <entity> — <step>'
- NextStepCoach reads 'Do next: <step>'
- pending: 'Settle' above, 'Do next' below

## Expected impact
Operators see one verb per rung across both coaches. Risk: NextStepCoach tests pin the present() wording.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one vocabulary for one ladder
Before: 2 of 5 rungs disagree on actionWord (pending, unproduced); 1 on hint meaning (held vs resolving)
After: 0 of 5 disagree
Method: simulation - walked pending/unproduced/fail through both sources; the fix file is out of scope so no gate run here
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: test: for each CoachPriority, pickNextActionableStep(...).actionWord (no verdict, index>0) === COACH_HINT[p].actionWord; today 2 rungs red

title: Move the lab banners and digest onto the lab type and spacing tokens
body:
## Summary
Six files in this context set raw px font sizes, gaps and radii while the two coaches beside them use --lab-fs-*/--lab-s*/--lab-r-* tokens; several sizes sit below the lab's own smallest type token.

## Description
src/components/layout-lab/lab-tokens.css:11 defines --lab-fs-xs: 14px as the floor. Raw px count (fontSize/gap/borderRadius/padding px): DriftBanner.tsx 6, ProduceErrorBanner.tsx 3, ProduceLogPanel.tsx 14, RefreshFromServer.tsx 2, RefreshCatalogFromServer.tsx 2, CatalogChangesDigest.tsx 13 = 40, lab-token uses 0. GlobalCoach.tsx 0 raw / 25 tokens, NextStepCoach.tsx 0 / 17. 12px text: src/components/layout-lab/RefreshFromServer.tsx:61, src/components/layout-lab/RefreshCatalogFromServer.tsx:61, src/components/layout-lab/CatalogChangesDigest.tsx:88,113,121,138,149,173, src/components/layout-lab/ProduceLogPanel.tsx:132,146. Fixed = these files read the lab tokens (design-tokens golden path), lifting sub-floor text to --lab-fs-xs.

## Flow
- open an entity: NextStepCoach text is 15px, the RefreshFromServer outcome under the rail is 12px
- change the lab density tokens: token surfaces follow, raw-px surfaces do not

## Expected impact
Consistent scale and a readable floor across the coach surfaces. Risk: denser rows (digest, produce log) grow; needs a visual check.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one type/spacing scale across the coach surfaces
Before: 40 raw px sites, 0 token uses in 6 files; 10 sites at 12px, below the 14px floor
After: 0 raw px, 0 below floor
Method: probe - grep count on the six files; the visual After needs a render pass
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: grep -oE "(fontSize|gap|borderRadius): [0-9]+|padding: '[0-9]+px" per file: 6/3/14/2/2/13; grep var(--lab-(fs|s|r)) per file: 0 each; src/components/layout-lab/lab-tokens.css:11 --lab-fs-xs: 14px
instrument: raw-px counter over the 6 files (ratchet to 0) + one screenshot per surface before/after

title: Narrow the drift and produce-error banners' live regions to their message
body:
## Summary
DriftBanner is role=status around its 'Adopt server truth' button and checkbox; ProduceErrorBanner is role=alert around its Dismiss button - the same over-wide live region fixed in NextStepCoach (a17b46d3).

## Description
src/components/layout-lab/DriftBanner.tsx:31 role="status" wraps the checkbox label (:66) and the Button (:71). src/components/layout-lab/ProduceErrorBanner.tsx:32 role="alert" wraps the Dismiss Button (:54). Fixed = the role sits on the message span only, controls outside it.

## Flow
- produce a step that fails with a screen reader running
- ProduceErrorBanner mounts; the alert reads the reason AND 'Dismiss the produce failure for <step>'

## Expected impact
Shorter announcements for AT users; no visual change. Risk: tests or e2e that query the banner by role.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - live announcements carry only the message
Before: 2 banners, 3 controls inside live regions
After: 0 controls inside live regions
Method: simulation - read the markup; the instrument is the a17b46d3 one (querySelector('button,input') inside [role=status],[role=alert])
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: component test: no <button>/<input> inside [role=status],[role=alert] of either banner; today 3 found

title: Pin ProduceErrorBanner's two survival sentences
body:
## Summary
ProduceErrorBanner has zero direct tests; its hasContent branch decides whether the operator is told earlier content survived.

## Description
grep of src/__tests__ for 'layout-lab/ProduceErrorBanner' returns 0 files. src/components/layout-lab/ProduceErrorBanner.tsx:47-49 chooses between 'the content from the previous successful run is still here' and 'nothing was produced for this step' - a swap would tell the operator their work is gone (or safe) wrongly and no gate would notice.

## Flow
- render with hasContent true/false
- assert the reason renders verbatim and the right survival sentence shows
- click Dismiss -> onDismiss called

## Expected impact
A regression in the Rule 4 failure banner's copy goes red. Nothing user-visible changes.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - the Rule 4 failure banner is gated
Before: 0 tests
After: 3 tests; a seeded swap of the ternary turns 2 red
Method: simulation - test not yet written; S instrument
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: src/components/layout-lab/ProduceErrorBanner.tsx:47 {hasContent ? ' · the content from the previous successful run is still here.' : ' · nothing was produced for this step.'}; grep -rl "layout-lab/ProduceErrorBanner'" src/__tests__ -> 0

title: Announce the changes digest's loading and arrival states
body:
## Summary
CatalogChangesDigest renders 'Reading what moved…' with no aria-busy or status role, so AT users get no signal the digest is loading or has landed.

## Description
src/components/layout-lab/CatalogChangesDigest.tsx:63 the loading state is a plain span; :82 the ready headline is a plain span; Shell (:165) carries no aria-busy or role. GlobalCoach's aria-busy section is the in-context pattern. Fixed = Shell takes aria-busy while loading and the headline sits in a polite status region (async-ui-states: 'Announced, not just drawn').

## Flow
- open a catalog board that has a baseline
- the digest reads 'Reading what moved…' then swaps to the headline
- a screen reader announces neither

## Expected impact
AT users learn what moved without hunting for it. Risk: one extra announcement on every board open.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - async states are announced, not just drawn
Before: 0 of 2 async states announced
After: 2 of 2
Method: simulation - read markup
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: src/components/layout-lab/CatalogChangesDigest.tsx:63 Reading what moved…; :165 Shell div has no aria-busy/role
instrument: component test: loading -> Shell aria-busy=true; ready -> headline inside [role=status]

title: Stop an entity with no steps reading 'All done.'
body:
## Summary
doneHeadline treats zero weaknesses over zero steps as verified, so an empty step list renders the unqualified 'All done.'

## Description
src/components/layout-lab/coachProvenance.ts:83 summarizeDoneProvenance([]) returns total 0, weak 0; :134 doneHeadline returns verified:true 'All done.' for weak===0. NextStepCoach (src/components/layout-lab/NextStepCoach.tsx:98) shows it whenever no next step exists, which an empty list guarantees. Fixed = total===0 returns an unverified 'No steps to check here.' Reachability depends on entityStepList returning [] for an entity (not traced).

## Flow
- open an entity whose pipeline resolves no steps
- coach reads 'All done.' with the ok tint

## Expected impact
Removes a vacuous pass claim. Risk: if empty step lists are unreachable this is defensive only.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - no verified claim over nothing
Before: doneHeadline(summarizeDoneProvenance([], f)).verified === true
After: false
Method: simulation - walked the pure functions; reachability through Baseline not traced
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: src/components/layout-lab/coachProvenance.ts:134 if (p.weak === 0) { return { verified: true, headline: 'All done.', detail: '' }; }
instrument: unit test on doneHeadline over [] + a trace that entityStepList can return [] for a seeded entity
